user.title: Watt Watcher
user.description: Pick the appliance and its power (W) sensor.

data_description.power_sensor: The smart plug's power sensor, in watts.
data_description.device_type: Sets the suggested state names and timings.

state_names.title: States
state_names.description: One state name per line. The first state is the start (power above its threshold), the last one is the finish (power below its threshold).

data_description.comparison: Whether this state applies above or below the threshold.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Controls when a cycle counts as started and finished. All values are in seconds.

data_description.active_delay: Power must stay above the threshold this long before a cycle starts.
data_description.finished_delay: Power must stay low this long before the cycle finishes. Pick something longer than the appliance's pauses between phases.
data_description.idle_delay: How long the finished state is shown before going idle.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Most people never need to change these.

data_description.resume_window: If power returns this soon after finishing, it counts as the same cycle resuming, not a new start. 0 = off.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the power sensor is read.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the power sensor being watched. Use Configure for states and timings.

error.min_two_states: At least two states are required.
error.reserved_name: 'idle' is used internally, pick another name.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already being watched.

init.description: What do you want to change?
